title: Your website
is not a {{moodboard}}
slides.body: It is a sales conversation. Pretty helps. Clear sells.

title: Most service sites
hide the offer
slides.body: They open with vague identity copy, bury the actual service, and make a stranger work too hard to understand why they should care.

slides.before: Helping brands unlock their potential through innovative solutions and meaningful storytelling.
slides.takeaway: A buyer should know what you do, who it is for, and why it matters before they have to scroll like they are solving a crime.

title: Name the buyer
before the {{benefit}}
slides.body: A strong page makes the right person feel immediately addressed. Not everyone. The person with the problem you actually solve.

title: Turn services
into outcomes
slides.body: Do not list deliverables like a receipt. Show the business result. Sharper positioning. Better conversion paths. Cleaner sales conversations.

title: Every section
needs a job
slides.body: Hero earns attention. Proof earns trust. Offer explains value. CTA creates motion. Anything else is probably decoration wearing business casual.

title: Want me
to audit your
website {{copy}}?
slides.body: Book a strategy session or start with a positioning audit at mkparrish.com. I will find the fog and make the page easier to buy from.
